Over six decades in Varanasi's silk trade

Rajlaxmi Silk Emporium began in 1960 with one aim: to preserve the timeless beauty of Indian handloom and bring it to families who value it.

Every saree is picked for its quality, tradition and elegance. Each one comes with the length, fabric and care details printed on its card, so you know exactly what you are buying.
